text:
alex: Quick sync — consolidating postmortem follow-ups from last week's GPU surge. I created an "action lane" so we can track ownership + timelines in one place. I can take the first pass to consolidate, but need owners confirmed.

maya: thanks. can you list the current high-priority items?

alex: short list: 1) scheduler tuning (reduce pod preemption on the big-req queue) — owner: ? — target: 2w 2) quota backstop (short-term soft quota bump + automation) — owner: ? — target: 1w 3) headroom guardrail (predictive headroom threshold + alerting) — owner: ? — target: 3w 4) burst autoscale policy (cap burst nodes to avoid cross-tenant eviction) — owner: ? — target: 2w

sam: I can pick up scheduler tuning. will carve out time tomorrow to prototype a change and run canary on staging.

maya: i'll take quota backstop automation. plan: add a temporary policy in terraform + a webhook to notify finance for approvals. estimate 3 days.

li: headroom guardrail sounds like infra/reliability work — happy to partner. can we split into detection + mitigation? detection (metric + model) then mitigation (scaling policy).

alex: yes split makes sense. detection owner: li, mitigation owner: li+eng-sre (pat). list of action items i'll add to the lane: - scheduler-tuning: owner=sam, due=2743340000 - quota-backstop: owner=maya, due=2743270000 - headroom-detect: owner=li, due=2743410000 - headroom-mitigate: owner=pat, due=2743520000 - burst-cap: owner=alex, due=2743345000

pat: FYI — I logged a quick draft of the burst-cap constraints into the playbook repo. link: https://git.internal/redwood/playbooks/capacity#burst-cap (old draft)

ops-bot: deploybot: canary deploy queued: scheduler-tuning-proto by sam -> staging at 2026-04-05T09:30Z

sam: ack, i'll run the canary and post results here. if latency regresses >5% we rollback.

maya: for quota-backstop: proposed sequence 
1) temporary soft bump (30%) via admin console 
2) automation that reverts after 72h unless new quota request approved 
3) postmortem note to finance with usage evidence

alex: good. add the automation as an infra-ticket and include audit logging requirement. compliance wants KMS events for any quota change.

li: about recurring pattern detection — I noticed 3 surges over last 6 weeks with same request-shape: long-context gen + embeddings prep. Could we add a quick eval that tags requests >6k tokens and routes them to a lower-priority pool?

sam: routing by request-shape is feasible. but need to measure percent of traffic it affects; if it's <1% worth isolating, if >10% we need dedicated pool. i'll run a sampling job and post numbers.

alex: action items & owners (finalized for now): 
- sam: scheduler-tuning canary + metric report (due 2743300000) 
- maya: quota-backstop automation + terraform change (due 2743270000) 
- li: headroom detection prototype + rule (due 2743410000) 
- pat: headroom mitigation policy draft + playbook update (due 2743520000) 
- alex: burst autoscale cap policy + rollout plan (due 2743345000) 

pat: i'll add the playbook checklist: "who to call", escalation dial, and rollback knobs. will ping on PR.

maya: once quota-backstop is live i'll also add a small dashboard widget for the finance team.

sam: can we have a weekly 15-min slot for progress on the lane? same time each Wed?

alex: yes let's do Wed 10am PT. recurring invite incoming.

li: one more thing — recommend we add a recurring analysis to the postmortem template: "request-shape heatmap" to surface recurring incident fingerprints. will make a PR to the template.

alex: love it. closing notes: i'll publish the consolidated lane doc after this thread and tag owners. if you want items moved or different due dates reply here. change log will be in the lane doc + playbook PRs. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks alex.

sam: thanks, will report canary results by EOD tomorrow.

li: on it.

ops-bot: reminder: weekly lane sync scheduled 2026-04-08T17:00Z

alex: thread closed for now — reopen if blockers show up.
